observations: Predicted €5 off gives lower total for €20 basket.
Tests gave percentage €16 versus fixed €15. At €25 both €20; maximum €40 gave percentage €32 versus fixed €35.
Screenshot used receipt icons and result cards. Reveal preserved initial/current context and explained equality at 20% of €25 = €5.
whyCool: The best coupon changes when the basket crosses a simple threshold.
caveat: Fictional offers exclude actual restrictions; no threshold graph.
effort: Prediction, both tests, exact crossover, maximum boundary, screenshot and reveal.
bucketReason: Useful decision rule demonstrated on both sides of equality.

prediction.reason: Concrete comparable offers with plausible choices and no exclusions.

interaction.reason: Controlled change checked equality and reversal across threshold.

clarity.reason: Final total comparison and expressions are explicit.

transfer.reason: Concrete threshold gives a reusable decision condition.

surprise.reason: Winning offer reverses with basket size.
surprise.evidence: Fixed wins below threshold, percentage above.

visualExplanation.reason: Receipt icons do not show threshold or slopes.

playfulness.reason: Finding crossover supports exploratory slider use.
